title: refactor(ci): split lint/test workflows, improve cache & parallelism, bump actions
author: Evan Liu
description: Motivation: Our monolithic CI workflow has grown slow and fragile as we add more linting rules, TypeScript checks, and cross-repo test matrices. This PR splits lint and test into dedicated workflows, improves cache key hygiene and parallelism for test jobs, and bumps GitHub Actions and Node versions where safe. Summary of changes: split .github/workflows/lint.yml and .github/workflows/test.yml from a combined ci.yml; introduce a reusable test job in .github/workflows/jobs/test-template.yml; add per-package cache keys using package-lock checksum and workspace path; adjust test matrix to run Node 18 only for heavy integration jobs and Node 20 for fast unit suites; enable job-level concurrency and cancel-in-progress to reduce queue backlog; bump actions/checkout to v4 and actions/cache to v4; remove deprecated uses of setup-node legacy cache; small package.json devDeps bumps (eslint 9.x, typescript 5.x) and update CI helper scripts. Checklist: - [x] Split workflows and wire up required permissions - [x] Preserve previous status badges and release automation triggers - [x] Validate caching hit rates locally - [x] Run full test matrix in staging. Why: incremental performance wins (shorter startup, higher cache hit rate, more parallelism) and improved hygiene to make future changes easier to review. Rollout: staged merge to main with monitoring, subsequent follow-up to tune matrix size and flaky test tagging.

Tomáš Novák: Cache keys are safer but we should avoid storing node_modules in the top-level cache for workspace runs; Author reply: adjusted cache scope to per-package node_modules and added a helper that prunes absolute paths

Priya Desai: Tests looked flaky on Node 20 in the matrix — recommend running Node 20 only for lint and non-integration suites; Author reply: limited Node 20 to unit/lint jobs, left integration on Node 18 as requested
